text: Handling deadlines is a crucial skill that can reduce stress and improve your work quality. The first step is effective time management, which means breaking large tasks into smaller, manageable steps and scheduling them into your calendar. Next, learn to prioritize: identify which tasks are most important or urgent, and tackle those first. Scope management is also essential—be realistic about what you can achieve and avoid taking on too much extra work. Finally, maintain open communication with your team or clients. If you foresee a delay, let them know early and suggest a revised timeline. This builds trust and often leads to more flexible solutions. With these strategies, you can meet your deadlines confidently and calmly.
